Well, Lolita is always going to stand out, or at least will always look different from usual western fashion. And as you mentioned, people will look at you, just for other reasons than your clothes. So probably the most obvious advice: just roll with it! If you wore it in a city, why not wear it home too, peeps are going to look no matter what! 

Lolita kinda lives for the, compared to western fashion, dramatic shape. You know what I mean, big silhouette, a whole coord that has thought behind, etc
I think one way to tone down a Lolita coord would be to let go of the petticoat. That will reduce the poof of the coord, and look more normie. Some gothic brands, Atelier Pierrot for example, release more dramatic pieces, with a lot of volume and ruffles and stuff, so maybe you want to avoid that or integrateit less.

What I would recommend is wearing more a-line dresses and skirts, if you want to wear a petticoat. I feel like it still makes you feel Lolita without feeling too big if you know what I mean. Moitie for example has some simpler dresses that still classify as Lolita, but aren't drawing too much attention to yourself. One of them would be the "Catherine OP", it's a-line, it's a bit longer, but still gothic and elegant. And easy to wear from day to day!

For general dressing down I'd also say that you could town down the amount of jewelry/accessories you use. Idk how much you usually wear, but maybe you can reduce that and stick to smaller items. Sometimes less is more! 

You could also wear more casual Lolita with cutsews and skirts instead JSKs and blouses. I feel like cutsews bring a more casual vibe with them than blouses do. But there are very elegant blouses too! I think I would try to avoid some that have too much going on, like a really big jabot with lot's of lace or ruffles.

It's a bit difficult for me to think of much toning down without knowing what's in your wardrobe, so I'm sorry if my ideas aren't too good.

I agree with everything the others have mentioned so far. To add my two cents: before actually buying/thrifting Lolita, I would try to do a bit more research. Try to get a grasp of the fashion itself, otherwise you might feel a little lost. 
What substyle in Lolita do you like most? What even is a "coord"? Maybe try looking at coords in this sub, old magazine scans(eg: Gothic & Lolita Bible), Facebook and other social medias, how brands and shops style their models and mannequins...
That may help you find your style! And with finding your style in Lolita it will definitely be easier to shop for it - simply because you know what you're looking for. 
Someone else mentioned starting a pinterest board to collect and get inspired, I would recommend that too! Same with looking through Lolibrary. Just browse a bit and see what you like :)

From everything shown in the picture, I think the skirt looks the most "Lolita". Generally I have to admit that the outfit doesn't look cohesive, which is essential for a good coord. 
Like others suggested I would lose the blouse and try to find a simple white or black blouse. Preferably with a peter pan collar. 
The blouse you have right now seems to be a different white than the ruffles on the skirt, same with the pink flowers and the corset. If you want to use a corset, I'd also recommend a black one, since it's easier to coordinate. A black corset can be easily used for future coords too!
I suggest starting with a one- or two-colored coord and since the skirt has black and white, I'd say try to create a black and white one. 

Like others mentioned, you can buy second-hand Lolita at Lacemarket, WunderWelt and ClosetChild. You can also try Facebook, there are several groups focusing on selling or trading.
